intro: Run Codex headlessly in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and automation scripts. Always: branch → task → test → PR.

sections.title: GitHub Actions — Auto-Fix Lint Errors
sections.code:
name: Auto-fix lint
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: contains(github.event.label.name, 'autofix')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { ref: "${{ github.head_ref }}" }

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '20', cache: 'npm' }

      - run: npm ci

      - name: Run Codex
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          npx @openai/codex --approval-mode full-auto --quiet \
            "Fix all ESLint errors. Only fix what lint reports."

      - run: npm test

      - run: |
          git config user.name "Codex Bot"
          git config user.email "codex@ci"
          git diff --quiet || git commit -am "fix: auto-fix lint via Codex" && git push

sections.title: Safe CI Pattern — Always Gate with Tests
sections.code:
# Always: run on a branch, gate with tests
git checkout -b codex/autofix-$(date +%Y%m%d)

npx @openai/codex --approval-mode full-auto --quiet "$TASK" \
  && npm test \
  || (echo "Codex changes broke tests" && git checkout . && exit 1)

git push -u origin HEAD
gh pr create --title "Codex: $TASK"

items.title: Never use user-supplied input as the task
items.body: If the Codex task comes from an external source (GitHub comment, webhook), sanitise it first. Injected tasks can cause Codex to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: Always run on a branch, never main
items.body: full-auto on main is irreversible. Always checkout -b before running Codex in automated contexts.

items.title: Review Codex PRs before merging
items.body: For production codebases, the CI creates a PR and a human reviews before merge. full-auto + review is the safest CI pattern.
